governance.zero_data_fabrication_rule: Zero synthetic Bid/Ask prices or continuous quote surfaces may be labeled as exchange observations.

intraday_requirements.minimum_sessions_threshold_explanation: 250 verified sessions is a PROJECT_RESEARCH_THRESHOLD defined to guarantee statistical validity across a full calendar year of trading regimes. It is not a universal statistical law.
intraday_requirements.substitution_rule: Substitution of daily or 1-hour bars for 1m/5m intraday data is strictly forbidden.

options_requirements.best_available: Level 4 / Order-book capable (tick-by-tick order & trade logs)

options_hierarchy.LEVEL_3: Continuous Paired Bid/Ask (>= 70% paired quote continuity across market hours)
options_hierarchy.LEVEL_4: Depth / Order-Book Capable (5-depth or full order book reconstruction)

options_requirements.paired_quote_continuity_explanation: The 70% paired quote continuity threshold is a PROJECT_RESEARCH_THRESHOLD defined for internal execution modeling. It is not an industry-wide or universal definition of execution readiness.

contract_validation.required_foundation: Authoritative exchange specifications + market calendar + actual contract metadata. Expired contracts must remain identifiable and queryable.

primary_candidate.name: NSE Data & Analytics / DotEx
primary_candidate.suitability: Preferred candidate subject to vendor confirmation, formal quotation, licensing review, and successful sample validation.

secondary_candidate.name: TrueData (TrueData India)
secondary_candidate.suitability: Secondary candidate subject to vendor confirmation of historical options Bid/Ask depth, formal quotation, and sample validation.

backup_candidate.name: Global DataFeeds (GDFL)
backup_candidate.suitability: Backup candidate subject to vendor confirmation of historical options archives, formal quotation, and sample validation.

provisional_candidate_ranking.disclaimer: This provisional ranking is NOT a purchasing recommendation. No data purchase or commercial commitment is authorized.
